questions.q_en: In a class of 62 students M's rank from the top was 36th. P's rank was 29th from the bottom. How many students had a rank between M's rank and P's rank?
questions.solution_en:
M's rank from the top is 36th.

P's rank from the top = (Total students - P's rank from bottom) + 1

= (62 - 29) + 1

= 33 + 1 = 34th

Students between their rank= (M's rank from the top - P's rank from top)- 1

= (36 - 34) - 1

= 2 - 1

= 1
questions.solution_hi:
M's rank from the top is 36th.

= (62 - 29) + 1

= 33 + 1 = 34th

Students between their rank= (M's rank from the top - P's rank from top)- 1

= (36 - 34) - 1

= 2 - 1

= 1

questions.q_en: Four different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which have numbers 12, 32, 52, 72, 92 and 42. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having number '92'.
questions.solution_en:
From the above given three different positions of the same dice, it can be concluded that,

· Face having number '12' is not opposite to the face with numbers 52, 32, 92 and 42 because these numbers are adjacent to the face with number '12'.

So, the face having number '12' is opposite to the face having number '72'.

· Face having number '32' is not opposite to the face with numbers 42, 72, 12 and 52 because these numbers are adjacent to the face with number '32'.

So, the face having number '32' is opposite to the face having number '92'.

· Face having number '42' is adjacent to face with numbers 12, 92, 32 and 72.

So, the face having number '42' is opposite to the face having number '52'.

questions.q_en: The Time shown on a clock is 8 hours 16 minutes, what time will appear in the water?
questions.solution_en:
If the Minutes are less than 30, then subtract the given time from 18:30 hours.

If the Minutes are more than 30, then subtract the given time from 17:90 hours.

Here, minutes are less than 30,

Thus, 18:30 - 8:16 = 10:14

Hence, the water image will appear at 10 hours 14 minutes.
